rationale: The robot's performance indicated issues with line tracking stability, evidenced by 2 line loss events and a maximum error of 0.060533. To address this, I increased the kp value from 0.7 to 0.8 to enhance responsiveness. Additionally, I reduced the side sensor weights to 0.8 to prioritize the center sensor, which should improve tracking stability and reduce line loss events. I expect these changes to lead to a decrease in line loss events and a lower maximum error in future trials.
